items.title: 68356_Howard R. Scott oral history interview
items.q: I don't know whether he took it over from Snowden or not

ctx.x: He had taken over the band from (inaudible) at that point.
No, he had his own band. He had his own band. I don't know whether he took it over from Snowden or not, because when I joined he had his own band.
And did Fletcher see Duke as a threat, an upcoming rival?
